quotes.text: Recorded BCT3 triage found several distinct accessibility failure groups. A change that made splitter handles tabbable altered the global tab path, while other reported failures involved different controls. For a current BCT failure, confirm the actual job, test path, error, platform, and revision before linking it to that change; a local macOS result does not establish a Linux CI result.
